simple.meaning: עָרַץ (ʻârats) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to awe or (intransitive) to dread ; hence, to harass.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 15 times across Deuteronomy, Joshua, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, beginning at Deuteronomy 1:29. Its contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָרַץ (H6206).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: to awe or (intransitive) to dread ; hence, to harass
definitions.usage: be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly.
definitions.full: H6206. arats [ עָרַץ ] verb cause to tremble, tremble (in terror, or awe) (compare Arabic quiver, flicker ; Syriac come upon suddenly or violently , PS under the word passim ; compare Egyptian ±u-ra-¼-au(t) , they terrified (= ערצו ) WMM As.u.Eur.76 ); — Qal Imperfect 2masculine singular תַּעֲרֹץ Deut 7:21 +; 2 feminine singular תַּעֲר֑וֺצִי Isa 47:12 ; 1 singular אֶעֱרוֺץ Job 31:34 , etc.; Infinitive construct עֲרֹץ Isa 2:19 +; — 1 cause to tremble (i.e. strike with awe) with accusative הָאָרֶץ Isa 2:19 , 21 (subject ׳י ; insert probably also 2:10 ); ׳תַּע נִדָּף הֶעָלֶה Job 13:25 wilt thou strike with awe the driven leaf ? absolute cause trembling = inspire awe Isa 47:12 (of Babylonian ), Psa 10:18 . 2 intransitive tremble, feel dread (D), Deut 1:29 ; 7:21 ; 20:3 ; 31:6 ; Josh 1:9 ; with accusative Job 31:34 because I stood in awe of the great multitude. Niph`al Participle נַעֲרָץ אֵל Psa 89:8 El, terrible in the company of the holy ones (|| נוֺרָא ). Hiph`il 1. regard , or treat, with awe, as awful: 2masculine plural תַעֲרִ֑יצוּ וְלֹא Isa 8:12 (accusative מוֺרָאוֺ ); 3 masculine plural יַעֲרִ֑יצוּ 29:23 accusative יִשׂ ׳אֶתאֱֿלֹהֵי . 2 inspire with awe (compare Qal 2 ); — Participle suffix מַעֲִרצְכֶם הוּא Isa 8:13 he shall be your awe-inspirer .

occurrences.englishText: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.
You shall not be scared of them; for Yahweh your God is among you, a great and awesome God.
and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God† The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim). is with you wherever you go.”
Will you harass a driven leaf?
because I feared the great multitude,
to judge the fatherless and the oppressed,
Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you?
Men shall go into the caves of the rocks,
to go into the caverns of the rocks,
“Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor be terrorized.
Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the middle of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
